nota.titulo: Exportaciones de vehículos eléctricos de China suben 145% por la guerra en Irán
nota.resumen: Las exportaciones de EV de China crecieron 145% en octubre, impulsadas por mayor demanda extranjera tras la guerra en Irán.
nota.resumenOriginal: China’s electric vehicle (EV) exports hit an all-time high for a second straight month in October, as the country’s carmakers rode a surge in overseas demand driven by the Middle East energy shock. Chinese brands sold a total of 582,000 pure electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles outside mainland China last month, a 144.7 per cent jump from a year earlier, according to data from the China Passenger Car Association (CPCA).
